style.Stats: background: var(--on-cream); padding: 64px 100px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 24px; @media(--tablet){ padding: 56px 40px; } @media(--mobile){ padding: 48px 20px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 32px; }
style.Stat 1: flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 0px; width: auto; align-items: flex-start; @media(--mobile){ width: calc(50% - 16px); }
style.Stat 1 number: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.3px; letter-spacing: 0px; font-size: 64px; line-height: 64px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%); background-clip: text; color: transparent; @media(--tablet){ font-size: 52px; line-height: 54px; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 44px; line-height: 46px; }
style.Stat 1 label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--on-navy); line-height: 1.4; @media(--tablet){ font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; }
style.Stat divider 1: width: 1px; min-width: 1px; height: 80px; padding: 0px; background: var(--on-line); @media(--mobile){ display: none; }
